title: TRUSTWORTHY AI AND DEMOCRACY: A DUAL TAXONOMY OF DEMOCRATIC RISKS AND CONTRIBUTIONS

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation through a literature review of over 100 publications and the development of the AI Risks to Democracy (AIRD) taxonomy, conceptually analyzing how biased training data and opaque models perpetuate systemic discrimination, structural injustice, and harm toward marginalized groups.

Qualitative evaluation via literature review and conceptual taxonomy mapping, analyzing how algorithmic personalization, micro-targeting, and recommender systems foster ideological echo chambers, political polarization, and fragmented public discourse.
